bio.title: BIOGRAPHY
bio.label: BIOGRAPHY
bio.default_para1: Mouhamed VJ, a prodigy of Senegalese music, started singing at the age of 13. At 17, he made a sensation with his first single, "Dans tes bras", which was a great success. Thanks to an already well-established audience on his social networks, he manages to organize a sold-out concert with only a few songs to his credit.
bio.default_para2: In 2022, he released his first EP titled "En Vrai" under the Hoside label, consolidating his presence on the Senegalese music scene. He then continues his success by filling the biggest stages in the country, such as the esplanade of the Dakar Grand Theater, Canal Olympia and the esplanade of the Museum of Black Civilizations.
bio.default_para3: In 2023, VJ takes a new step by signing with the Rec 118 label of Warner Music, in collaboration with Hoside and BLZ. With over 90 million views on YouTube and millions of streams, he establishes himself as an essential figure on the Senegalese music scene.

youtube_record.title: Historic YouTube Record
youtube_record.description: His song Kaay Waay is the most viewed clip in history for a solo Senegalese artist, accumulating over 63 million views.

platinum_single.title: Platinum Single AMC
platinum_single.description: Obtained with his hit song Kaay Waay, making him the very first Senegalese single to achieve this certification.

gold_album.title: Gold Album AMC
gold_album.description: Obtained thanks to the success of his track Ya Meun, consolidating his position as a musical leader.

digital_audience.title: Impressive Digital Audience
digital_audience.description: He accumulates over 100 million views on his official YouTube channel and gathers millions of streams on all platforms.

ambassador.title: Dakar 2026 Ambassador
ambassador.description: In July 2026, VJ was officially appointed Ambassador of the Youth Olympic Games (YOG) Dakar 2026 by the organizing committee to promote the event to young people.

legendary_performances.title: Legendary Performances
legendary_performances.description: He holds records for precocity by filling massive esplanades at the age of 17-18 (Dakar Grand Theater Esplanade, Canal Olympia) and performed sold-out in the mythical La Cigale hall in Paris.
